cases.description: The unedited reading with 1 s of room tone before it and 3 s after: nothing should be found.
Two stretches of speech driven hot and hard-clipped: 1 s at +20 dB in paragraph 7 and 0.5 s at +14 dB in paragraph 13.
Everything after paragraph 10 is 9 dB quieter, as if the gain or mic distance changed between sessions.
A 2 ms click peaking at -6 dBFS in the middle of the pause after paragraphs 3, 7, 12 and 17.

edits.knownIssue: The reader's room tone in this pause sits at -49 to -52 dBFS in 10 ms windows, at the -50 dBFS silence floor, so the click has no silent flank (clickFlankWindows) and is not offered.

cases.description: 2 ms clicks peaking at -24 dBFS, closer to a real mouth click, in the middle of the pause after paragraphs 3, 7 and 12.
A 2 ms click peaking at -6 dBFS at the end of the pause after paragraph 12, just before the reader's breath.

edits.knownIssue: A click that touches a breath is folded into one breath candidate, so it is not offered as a click.

cases.description: 8 s of room tone after paragraph 8 and 4 s after paragraph 15: long pauses in the read.
Exact digital silence (a dropout or a hard gate) for 0.6 s after paragraph 5 and 1.5 s after paragraph 14.
White noise at -50 dBFS RMS over the whole file: a noise floor well above ACX's -60 dBFS.

White noise at -56 dBFS RMS from the pause after paragraph 15, inside the unedited reading's one long steady room-tone stretch: the room tone rises mid-chapter but stays under the -50 dBFS silence floor.

edits.knownIssue: A silence's level is its mean, which on real narration is set by breath tails at -53 to -59 dBFS rather than the -67 dBFS room: the noise raises those means about 3 dB, under the 6 dB room-tone step, and a louder noise crosses the -50 dBFS silence floor and leaves no silences to measure.

cases.description: 0.15 s of room tone before the first word and 12 s after the last: head too short, tail too long for ACX.
